origin: CARLA 0.9.14 expert driving demonstrations, not physical-car mocap
selection_reason: Moderate measured sideslip; flat scenario; source onset and exit retained. Selection is source screening, not policy/checkpoint selection.
coordinate_conversion: CARLA left-handed Z-up -> right-handed Z-up: y and vy negated; yaw, yaw-rate and sideslip signs negated; degrees converted to radians.
clock: CSV has no timestamps/frame IDs. Recorder is asynchronous with fixed physics step 0.005s and client loop capped at 120Hz. Reconstruct approximate time from position increments and average velocity; preserve duplicate rows, never assume exact uniform sampling.
validation_extension: Keep same-actor sim2sim, tracking and stable-exit checks. Add moving-grounded sideslip duration and actual wheel-ground lateral contact-slip evidence. Do not reuse jump-flight gates.
limitations: Scenario a starts already moving near 120km/h; no expert acceleration from standstill.
Captured samples show active steering with no throttle/hand-brake input; inertia drift, not power drift.
The source filename success flag does not establish absolute sideslip/yaw-rate recovery.
Vehicle controls are source evidence, not TRON1 wheel-torque targets.
Car pose and reconstructed clock require explicit spatial/time adaptation before robot retargeting.
This source capture does not create a robot policy or prove physical feasibility.
